result_summary.title: Subscription Not Renewing and Incorrect Invoice Amount
result_summary.description: We have a single customer in the ANZ production environment whose subscription failed to renew automatically, and their subsequent invoice has an incorrect total. We've looked at the settings and we think this is absolutely a policy misconfiguration on our side regarding how renewal rules are applied, so we are fixing that now. Just opening this ticket to see if the system generated the wrong invoice data due to that config error or if there is something else going on with Payment Gateway v2.
